title: Dr. Dozie Ikedife, President General of Ohanaeze Ndigbo, expressed concerns about the marginalization of the Igbo people in Nigeria during an interview. He highlighted the lack of infrastructure development in the Southeast, including the neglect of federal roads, power stations, and research institutes. Ikedife criticized the previous administration for its insensitivity towards the region's needs and pointed out the absence of representation from the Southeast in key government positions. He also mentioned the recent flagging off of the second Niger Bridge as a potential step towards addressing transportation issues, but emphasized that more needs to be done to rectify the longstanding neglect of the region.
